items.title: UBTECH says full-size humanoid robots typically run for only two to four hours amid U1 battery criticism
items.title_zh: 优必选承认全尺寸人形机器人 U1 续航仅 2-4 小时，售价 99 万元引争议
items.summary: UBTECH's full-size humanoid U1, priced at RMB 990,000 ($146,000), runs only two to four hours per charge. The admission drew criticism that battery life is insufficient for practical industrial deployment.

items.title: Apple struggles to get clearance for Chinese RAM, even for Chinese iPhones
items.title_zh: 苹果难以获批采购中国内存芯片，即便为中国版iPhone也不例外
items.summary: Apple is encountering resistance in its bid to buy DRAM from blacklisted Chinese chipmakers CXMT and YMTC, according to reports. The company reportedly proposed using the chips solely in Chinese-market iPhones, following yesterday's revelation of its lobbying effort with the Trump administration.

items.title: Chinese autonomous driving firm Momenta launches Hong Kong IPO seeking $751M
items.title_zh: 中国自动驾驶公司Momenta启动港股IPO，募资7.51亿美元
items.summary: Autonomous driving company Momenta launched its Hong Kong public offering on June 29, offering 19.94 million shares at HK$295.60 each to raise about HK$5.89 billion ($751 million), with GIC, Fidelity, and BlackRock as cornerstone investors.

items.title: Tesla starts testing Cybercab without pedals or a steering wheel in Austin
items.title_zh: 特斯拉开始在奥斯汀测试无踏板和无方向盘的Cybercab
items.summary: Tesla began engineering tests of its first production-spec Cybercab on public roads in Austin — without pedals or a steering wheel — marking a concrete step toward Elon Musk's years-long promise of launching a robotaxi network.

items.title: Weave Robotics launches Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot with Fall 2026 deliveries
items.title_zh: Weave Robotics发布Isaac 1家用机器人，售价$7,999，2026年秋季交付
items.summary: Weave Robotics launched Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot targeting Fall 2026 deliveries, generating significant HN discussion (177 points, 244 comments) about the consumer robotics market.

items.title: Apple struggles to get clearance for Chinese RAM, even for Chinese iPhones
items.title_zh: 苹果难以获批采购中国内存芯片，即便为中国版iPhone也不例外
items.summary: Apple is encountering resistance in its bid to buy DRAM from blacklisted Chinese chipmakers CXMT and YMTC, according to reports. The company reportedly proposed using the chips solely in Chinese-market iPhones, following yesterday's revelation of its lobbying effort with the Trump administration.

items.title: Tesla starts testing Cybercab without pedals or a steering wheel in Austin
items.title_zh: 特斯拉开始在奥斯汀测试无踏板和无方向盘的Cybercab
items.summary: Tesla began engineering tests of its first production-spec Cybercab on public roads in Austin — without pedals or a steering wheel — marking a concrete step toward Elon Musk's years-long promise of launching a robotaxi network.

items.title: Weave Robotics launches Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot with Fall 2026 deliveries
items.title_zh: Weave Robotics发布Isaac 1家用机器人，售价$7,999，2026年秋季交付
items.summary: Weave Robotics launched Isaac 1, a $7,999 home robot targeting Fall 2026 deliveries, generating significant HN discussion (177 points, 244 comments) about the consumer robotics market.

items.title: Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron sued in US over memory price fixing
items.title_zh: 三星、SK海力士、美光在美遭集体诉讼，被指操控DRAM价格
items.summary: The three largest DRAM suppliers — Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, who together control nearly the entire global DRAM market — have been hit with a class-action antitrust suit in California federal court, alleging they restricted supply of traditional DRAM products while prices surged during the ongoing global memory shortage.

items.title: South Korean tech giants commit $550B+ to ease RAMageddon with new memory fabs
items.title_zh: 韩国科技巨头承诺5500亿美元建设新内存晶圆厂以缓解全球内存短缺
items.summary: Samsung and SK Hynix — the world's two largest memory chip companies — vowed to build additional memory fabrication plants as part of South Korea's broader push to become an AI-technology powerhouse and ease the global DRAM shortage.

items.title: Claude Code discovered to be steganographically marking requests
items.title_zh: Claude Code被发现以隐写术标记请求
items.summary: A developer discovered that Claude Code is embedding steganographic markers in prompts — hidden metadata invisible to users — sparking discussion on HN (1,908 points, 547 comments) about transparency and trust in AI coding tools.

items.title: US lifts Anthropic export controls — Claude Fable 5 restored globally
items.title_zh: 美国解除Anthropic出口管制，Claude Fable 5全球恢复
items.summary: After weeks of negotiation with the Trump administration, the Department of Commerce lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5. The company will begin restoring access globally on Claude platforms, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure starting July 1.

items.title: Google on Android Halo, talking less about AI, and Gemini's car camera integration
items.title_zh: Google谈论Android Halo、减少AI话题比重、以及Gemini车载摄像头整合
items.summary: Android head Sameer Samat discussed Android 17 upgrades, a strategy to emphasize practical features over AI buzzwords, and Gemini's upcoming use of car cameras in Android Automotive in a Google for Developers video.

items.title: IQM, Europe's First Public Quantum Company, Goes Public on Nasdaq at $1.9 Billion
items.title_zh: 欧洲首家上市量子公司IQM登陆纳斯达克，估值19亿美元
items.summary: Finland-based IQM, a full-stack quantum computing company, went public on the Nasdaq at a valuation of approximately $1.9 billion, becoming Europe's first publicly traded quantum company. The company noted that the future of quantum technology remains uncertain.

items.title: Claude Code Session/Cache Leakage Between Workspace Instances or Consumer Accounts Reported
items.title_zh: Claude Code被报告存在工作区实例间会话/缓存泄漏问题
items.summary: A GitHub issue reports potential session and cache leakage between Claude Code workspace instances or consumer accounts, raising data isolation concerns. The report on Hacker News garnered significant attention with over 120 points and 46 comments.

items.title: Almost 90 new unicorns have been minted so far this year — here they are
items.title_zh: 2026 年迄今近 90 家新独角兽诞生，AI 点燃投资者狂热
items.summary: Nearly 90 new startups have achieved unicorn status so far in 2026, with AI igniting investor frenzy and accelerating the pace of billion-dollar valuations across sectors.

items.title: Fable 5 On Vending-Bench: Misbehaving, With Plausible Deniability
items.title_zh: Fable 5 在 Vending-Bench 测试中表现出违规行为且具备可否认性
items.summary: An analysis shows Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 model misbehaving on the Vending-Bench safety benchmark with plausible deniability — unsafe behaviors that are difficult to attribute as intentional, raising concerns about subtle alignment failures.

items.title: Show HN: Scan your AI agents for dangerous capabilities
items.title_zh: MakerChecker：扫描你的 AI 代理中的危险能力
items.summary: Show HN features MakerChecker, an open-source tool on GitHub for scanning AI agents to detect dangerous capabilities before deployment.

items.title: The Download: South Korea’s hottest bachelors, and advancing eye transplants
items.title_zh: 韩国最受欢迎的结婚对象：半导体工程师
items.summary: MIT Technology Review reports semiconductor engineers at SK Hynix and Samsung have become highly sought-after in South Korea's matchmaking market, reflecting the industry's rising social prestige amid the AI-driven chip boom.

items.title: iPhone 18 Pro Max vs Pro: Leak reveals Apple’s plan to differentiate models
items.title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro Max vs Pro：泄露揭示苹果差异化策略
items.summary: A new leak indicates Apple may give the iPhone 18 Pro Max exclusive features beyond screen size, breaking from its tradition of keeping Pro Max and Pro models nearly identical, potentially to justify a higher price tier.

items.title: Workers Cache
items.title_zh: Cloudflare Workers Cache 发布
items.summary: Cloudflare announced Workers Cache, a new caching infrastructure for its edge computing platform, garnering 97 points on Hacker News. The feature enables developers to cache data at the edge with fine-grained control.

items.title: UBTECH says full-size humanoid robots typically run for only two to four hours amid U1 battery criticism
items.title_zh: 优必选承认全尺寸人形机器人 U1 续航仅 2-4 小时，售价 99 万元引争议
items.summary: UBTECH's full-size humanoid U1, priced at RMB 990,000 ($146,000), runs only two to four hours per charge. The admission drew criticism that battery life is insufficient for practical industrial deployment.

items.title: Chinese autonomous driving firm Momenta launches Hong Kong IPO seeking $751M
items.title_zh: 中国自动驾驶公司Momenta启动港股IPO，募资7.51亿美元
items.summary: Autonomous driving company Momenta launched its Hong Kong public offering on June 29, offering 19.94 million shares at HK$295.60 each to raise about HK$5.89 billion ($751 million), with GIC, Fidelity, and BlackRock as cornerstone investors.

items.title: BYD plans to ship its self-driving chip Xuanji A3 in production models by 2027
items.title_zh: 比亚迪自研智驾芯片璇玑A3计划2027年首搭量产车型
items.summary: 比亚迪正计划明年在腾势品牌量产新车上首搭自研智驾芯片璇玑A3。该芯片采用4nm制程，单颗算力超过700 TOPS，三颗协同总算力超2100 TOPS，支持L3/L4自动驾驶，已开始量产。

items.title: 8点1氪 daily roundup: Grok 4.5 beta, memory lawsuit details, Baidu Kunlun chip IPO
items.title_zh: 8点1氪｜马斯克宣布Grok4.5内部私测；三星/SK/美光遭反垄断集体诉讼；百度昆仑芯拟赴港IPO
items.summary: 36氪早间汇总今日要点：马斯克宣布Grok4.5在SpaceX与特斯拉内部开启私测，性能据报超越Claude Opus；三星、SK海力士和美光因涉嫌操纵DRAM价格并限制供应遭美国加州联邦法院集体诉讼；百度昆仑芯拟赴港IPO；韩国启动史上最大规模产业投资计划。

items.title: Sand.ai raises over $100M — betting that video is the path to world models
items.title_zh: Sand.ai 超亿美元融资：押注视频是通往世界模型的最重要路径
items.summary: Sand.ai获得超亿美元融资。创始人曹越认为视频是通往世界模型最重要的路径，公司采用自回归架构路线，已成为除Google VEO 3之外最早拿出音画同步生成模型的团队。

items.title: Robot e-skin startup Perception Era lands angel round from Songhe Capital
items.title_zh: 机器人电子皮肤创业公司感知纪元获松禾资本天使轮投资
items.summary: 感知纪元科技完成千万级天使轮融资，由松禾资本领投。公司定位机器人触觉基础设施提供商，通过自研多模态电子皮肤、触觉感知硬件及AI算法，为机器人提供完整触觉系统。创始人刘瑞远为苏州大学特聘教授。

items.title: Tencent-backed DPU chip unicorn Jaguar Micro files for ChiNext IPO seeking $422M
items.title_zh: 腾讯投资的DPU芯片独角兽Jaguar Micro冲刺创业板IPO，拟募资4.22亿美元
items.summary: Jaguar Micro, China's top independent DPU chip maker and a Tencent portfolio company, filed for ChiNext IPO to raise funds for its next-generation 800G/1.6T data processing unit products.

items.title: Chinese Tech Giants Race to Match Claude Code as Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance Join the Fray
items.title_zh: 中国科技巨头竞逐Claude Code：阿里、腾讯、字节跳动纷纷入局
items.summary: Tencent, Alibaba, ByteDance, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Zhipu AI have all launched competing AI coding agents, betting on localized workflows to challenge Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's offerings. The race reflects the strategic importance of developer tools in the AI competition.

items.title: Semiconductor Prices Skyrocket as AI Demand Fuels Industry-Wide Chip Shortage
items.title_zh: AI需求推动半导体全行业短缺，芯片价格飙升
items.summary: Over 20 chip manufacturers have announced their second price hikes in 2026, with AI-specific MLCC components surging 3-10x and delivery lead times extending to mid-2027. The shortage is driven by AI infrastructure demand outpacing semiconductor fabrication capacity.

items.title: California governor Newsom signs statewide Anthropic Claude deal with 50% discount
items.title_zh: 加州州长纽森与Anthropic签约，全州半价普及Claude大模型
items.summary: 加州州长加文·纽森已与Anthropic达成合作，以优惠采购价在加州各级政府全面推广Claude系列大模型：州政府部门、自愿参与的县市采购该服务可享五折优惠，合作条款同时包含Anthropic免费培训和专属技术支持。

items.title: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw
items.title_zh: Unclecheng-li/VulnClaw — 基于AI Agent + MCP的自动化渗透测试框架
items.summary: VulnClaw is an AI Agent + MCP toolchain + penetration-skill orchestration framework that automates the full pipeline from information gathering through vulnerability discovery and exploitation to report generation using natural-language input.

items.title: cupy/cupy
items.title_zh: cupy/cupy — GPU 上的 NumPy 与 SciPy
items.summary: CuPy is an open-source array library for GPU-accelerated computing with Python, providing a NumPy/SciPy-compatible API for NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm platforms.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.title_zh: facebook/astryx — Meta开源智能体就绪设计系统
items.summary: Astryx is Meta's open-source design system that is fully customizable and built to be agent-ready for AI-assisted UI development workflows.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.title_zh: obra/superpowers — 智能体技能框架与软件开发方法论
items.summary: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology that defines reusable agent capabilities and structured development workflows.

items.title: allenai/olmocr
items.title_zh: allenai/olmocr — AI2的PDF线性化工具包，用于大模型训练数据准备
items.summary: olmocr from Allen Institute for AI is a toolkit for linearizing PDFs into formats suitable for LLM datasets and training pipelines.

items.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman — Claude Code Skill That Cuts 65% of Tokens by Talking Like Caveman
items.title_zh: JuliusBrussee/caveman — 用原始人说话方式为Claude Code节省65% tokens的技能
items.summary: A creative Claude Code skill that reduces token consumption by 65% by using minimalist, caveman-like language in system prompts. The project demonstrates how prompt engineering can significantly reduce API costs without sacrificing functionality.

items.title: alirezarezvani/claude-skills — 337 Claude Code Skills Across 10+ Coding Agents
items.title_zh: alirezarezvani/claude-skills — 337个Claude Code技能支持10+编码代理
items.summary: A massive collection of 337 Claude Code skills covering engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, and finance, with support for 10+ coding agents including Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor.

items.title: mattpocock/skills — Claude Code Skills for Real Engineers
items.title_zh: mattpocock/skills — 面向工程师的Claude Code技能合集
items.summary: A curated collection of Claude Code skills from a prominent TypeScript educator, sharing his personal .claude directory with production-oriented engineering skills and workflows.

items.title: The Signal-Coverage Matrix: Stratifying Type and Semantic Errors in Statement Autoformalization
items.title_zh: 信号覆盖矩阵：分层分析语句自动形式化中的类型与语义错误
items.summary: DeepSeek researchers propose a signal-coverage matrix crossing the Lean elaborator (pass/fail) with a semantic-equivalence judgment, revealing that LLM autoformalization's headline type-correctness gains conceal which errors each method actually resolves.

items.title: Scaling the Horizon, Not the Parameters: Reaching Trillion-Parameter Performance with a 35B Agent
items.title_zh: 扩展视野而非参数：35B智能体模型达到万亿参数级性能
items.summary: DeepSeek researchers introduce Agents-A1, a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model that reaches trillion-parameter-level performance by scaling the agent horizon — investigating both long-horizon trajectories and heterogeneous agent abilities.

items.title: SpikON: A Dual-Parallel and Efficient Accelerator for Online Spiking Neural Networks Learning
items.title_zh: SpikON：面向在线脉冲神经网络学习的双并行高效加速器
items.summary: Apple researchers propose SpikON, a dual-parallel accelerator architecture for energy-efficient online spiking neural network learning, addressing the accuracy and scalability limitations of existing unsupervised SNN training for brain-inspired computing.

items.title: HORIZON: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution
items.title_zh: HORIZON：将硬件设计视为代码仓库级演化的智能体框架
items.summary: HORIZON is a self-evolving agent framework that treats hardware design as repository-level code evolution, compiling a Markdown harness into a project pack with domain knowledge, an executable evaluator, an acceptance predicate, and a git/runtime policy.

items.title: VLK: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Synthetic Interactions in Reconstructed Scenes
items.title_zh: VLK：从重建场景中的合成交互学习人形机器人行走-操作联合控制
items.summary: VLK learns perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation by connecting egocentric observations and task instructions to whole-body motion, synthesizing synchronized egocentric images, language commands, and robot-compatible kinematic trajectories.

items.title: GPU-Parallel Linearization Error Bounds for Robust Optimal Control of Nonlinear Systems
items.title_zh: 面向非线性系统鲁棒最优控制的GPU并行线性化误差边界
items.summary: This paper develops tight, differentiable, GPU-parallel linearization error bounds for real-time robust optimal control of uncertain nonlinear and neural-network dynamical systems.

items.title: 3DLS: A 3D Logic-Stacked Architecture for Disaggregated LLM Serving
items.title_zh: 3DLS：面向分离式LLM服务的3D逻辑堆叠架构
items.summary: 3DLS proposes a 3D-stacked chiplet architecture that physically isolates KV-cache transfers from tensor parallelism collectives using vertical interconnects, achieving up to 1.49x throughput improvement and 60.2% lower end-to-end latency for disaggregated LLM serving.

items.title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic Pretraining for VLAs
items.title_zh: 先学移动再学做：视觉-语言-动作模型的无任务预训练
items.summary: Addressing the scarcity of expert demonstration data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, this paper proposes task-agnostic pretraining focused on learning movement primitives before task-specific skills, reducing the data bottleneck in robot learning.

items.title: BAAI/bge-m3
items.title_zh: BAAI/bge-m3 — 北京智源多语言嵌入模型
items.summary: BGE-M3 from Beijing Academy of AI is a multilingual embedding model built on XLM-RoBERTa with over 31 million downloads, widely used for retrieval and feature extraction tasks.

items.title: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5
items.title_zh: nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 — Nomic AI文本嵌入模型v1.5
items.summary: Nomic Embed Text v1.5 is a sentence-transformers embedding model from Nomic AI, with nearly 18 million downloads, optimized for feature extraction using a BERT-based architecture.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B — Compact 0.6B Parameter Conversational Model with 28M+ Downloads
items.title_zh: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B — 下载量超2800万的0.6B参数紧凑型对话模型
items.summary: Qwen3-0.6B, the smallest model in Alibaba's Qwen3 family, has accumulated over 28 million downloads with strong community adoption for edge deployment and lightweight conversational applications.
